owner: original powerhouse-content-orchestrator (no new sender or scheduler)
root_cause: Original Powerhouse content-orchestrator independently generated a measuredNextPostTest challenger and a daily creativeExploration before calling bg_social_lus_cyclus; then concatenated measuredNextPostGuide + creativeExplorationGuide + linkedinLoopGuide into one text generator. A still-ACTIVE or new original LinkedIn one-variable experiment could therefore coexist with extra test copy changes in a single daily publication, destroying clean variant attribution and making learned effect untrustworthy.
fix: Explicit deterministic single-owner arbitration in existing measured-next-post-challenger helper after existing source SQL decision and before any AI prompt, editorial council and generation evidence. Original active LinkedIn experiment wins; fallback to existing evidence-backed measured challenger, then one reversible daily exploration, else no experiment. Suppressed candidates have zero proposed_test/single_change and no extra prompt instructions.
prevention_rule: Never attempt two independent creative experiment variables in one provider publication; only one active test owner may direct the existing editorial generator. Log selected owner and suppression in immutable original generation_evidence. No causal win from 4 exposures; verify actual provider post, source baseline and independent control/effect before promotion. Existing publisher identity/consent/quality/writer lease unaffected.

invariants: protected release and production source parity

terminal_rule: Protected Required/CodeQL/BRAIN success, merge, original Edge exact source parity; next naturally generated original content_artifact contains editorial_experiment_owner=ORIGINAL_LINKEDIN_LOOP when experiment active and both additional test sources suppressed; independent provider ID/readback, genuine exposure and business outcome evaluation remain separate evidence gates.
